title: Aggregate data entity over an aggregate measurement
instruction: Create a read-only aggregate data entity named ConFmRentalsByColor over the FMAggregateMeasurements measurement: the NoRentals measure from the FMRentalCharges group (EDT BIRCount) and the VehicleColor attribute of the FMVehicle dimension (EDT FMColorName) from the same group. Use only the d365fo CLI — do not hand-write XML.
